title: Magnetar Founder on AI’s Impact on Investors’ Mindsets
description: Alec Litowitz, Founder of Magnetar and now head of his family office, Qstar Capital, discusses his new book, "The Adaptability Quotient," which focuses on decision-making when old strategies stop working. He links the book’s themes to his experience at Magnetar, saying the firm looked for periods of rapid change because uncertainty often drives others away and creates opportunity for those first able to resolve it. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Skylar CIO: AI & Power Story Will Play Out Over Years
description: Bill Perkins discusses a new ETF built around short-dated electricity futures in PJM and ERCOT, saying it gives investors direct exposure to power pricing rather than to utilities themselves. He argues the product is timely because electricity demand is expected to grow, driven by manufacturing reshoring, data centers, and the broader AI buildout. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Crusoe Signs Roughly $13 Billion AI Cloud Deal With Jane Street
description: Crusoe, a data center upstart with contracts to supply AI computing power to the likes of Meta Platforms Inc. and Oracle Corp., has signed a cloud contract with trading firm Jane Street Group valued at around $13 billion, according to people with knowledge of the matter.
